title: Periodic Acid-Schiff Staining Protocol
author: Amanda Knoten
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.84mhyu6
materials: Oxidize in periodic acid solution for 5 minutes
Counterstain in Harris Hematoxylin for 3 minutes

steps.title: Rinse Samples
steps.instruction: Rinse the samples in distilled water.

steps.title: Apply Schiff Reagent
steps.instruction: Place the samples in Coleman’s Schiff reagent for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Initial Tap Water Rinse
steps.instruction: Rinse the samples in running tap water for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Wash Until Clear
steps.instruction: Wash the samples in running tap water until the water runs clear.

steps.title: Secondary Tap Water Rinse
steps.instruction: Rinse the samples in running tap water for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Ammonia Water Treatment
steps.instruction: Perform 10 dips in 1% Ammonia water for 30 seconds.
